taskSelection: Fixed before any T3 model outcomes: four known current scope/recovery diagnostics and a large-create control. No outcome-driven replacement.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, pinned installed dependencies, fresh identical fixture per paired task; no memory or solution retrieval. Provider nondeterminism, retries and cache are uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Existing USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard; stop starting trials at the registered panel observed estimate. Canary and global guards are separate. Not invoice caps; keep all missing usage and unexecuted planned trials.

ordering: Unchanged driver: manifest order in repetition one; reversed task and arm order in repetition two. Arm rotation uses the full task index, so indices >=3 retain base arm order. Sequential, no replacement or outcome-driven stopping.
quality: Primary: audited instruction criteria AND successful runtime completion. Register previously discovered Unicode extended marks and valid literal-percent storage key now as primary semantic checks, preserving original weighted scores and base adjudication separately. Keep all four timestamp/optional-field conventions. For fresh root/child/shared cases require all declared builds after the final edit and independently review source/input; no benchmark answers supplied.
accounting: Observe input+output tokens as primary efficiency, with task-matched audited-completion AND usage-reconciled pairs, plus whole-panel success/failure resources. Cache tokens are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output; do not double count. Preserve timeouts and missing request/cache/provider usage. Report task-cluster paired uncertainty. Category bytes measure repeated context exposure, not billed tokens; native categories absent.
decision: Execute canary and registered full panel irrespective of favorable efficiency point estimates unless a structural guard regression, access problem or configured budget prevents it. Hypothesis: visible execution scopes reduce unnecessary checks and resulting finish refusals, improving audited completion; then reduce matched reconciled resources. Mechanism endpoints: off-target child checks, task-selection refusals, blocked finish attempts, total tool/model calls. Do not relax failure admission; prefix overhead and omitted required dependent checks are regression risks. Retain only with supported mechanism and no observed required-check loss; publish adverse/inconclusive results.
